paragraphs: Inyani bar Susi: Jerusalem Talmud Berakhot, chapter 7, halakhah 2; in Jerusalem Talmud Sanhedrin, end of chapter 2, the reading is Rabbi Chanina bar Sisi.
Levi bar Sisi, the well-known sage.[^1]

notes.text: Guggenheimer Berakhot 7:2 reads Aniniya bar Sisai in its whole paragraph, beside Hyman’s Inyani bar Susi. The whole Sanhedrin 2:6 paragraph fully writes Rabbi Chanina bar Sisi, supporting that local title. These forms and the separate Levi pointer are retained without identifying their fathers.
